browserSuites: native Batch 2 physical placement and thumbnails
browserNotes: Native D3D11 cross-context controls showed small raster/compositor differences (1–2 channel levels) on unchanged assets/geometry/camera. Pixel proofs therefore use deterministic SwiftShader; all 61 final control production frames are byte-identical, with composited screenshot maximum delta 1. The early Buzzz SS/Buzzz-SS alias selection error was fixed by recorded catalog IDs. Software thumbnail testing correctly hit the existing atlas software-fallback guard, so thumbnail checks were moved to the separate native suite without changing the guard. These proof-harness issues were investigated and corrected, not counted as product failures or quietly discarded.
suiteNotes: All existing native suites passed on their first final run. Neither the known bag 3D timeout nor the editor save-dialog non-close occurred.
perfNotes: One full measured baseline and one full measured final default gate passed; no measured perf failure or rerun. Deltas are observed warm run-to-run medians, not a causal estimate of stamp cost. The atlas never requests these assets.
